buildCommand: rm -rf dist && mkdir dist && cp -R index.html styles.css sw.js manifest.json icon-192.png icon-512.png _headers css js data .well-known dist/ && find dist -type f ! -name '*.html' ! -name '*.css' ! -name '*.js' ! -name '*.json' ! -name '*.png' ! -name _headers -delete && find dist -type f -name '*.html' ! -path dist/index.html -delete && find dist -type f -name '.*' -delete

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; script-src-elem 'self'; script-src-attr 'none'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; font-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data: blob:; connect-src 'self' https://project-ref.supabase.co; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'; object-src 'none'
headers.Permissions-Policy: camera=(self), microphone=(self), geolocation=(self), accelerometer=(), autoplay=(), bluetooth=(), display-capture=(), encrypted-media=(), fullscreen=(self), gyroscope=(), hid=(), idle-detection=(), magnetometer=(), midi=(), payment=(), picture-in-picture=(), publickey-credentials-get=(), screen-wake-lock=(self), serial=(), usb=(), xr-spatial-tracking=()
